listing.name: Demon's Souls — DemonsSoulsPC (Leonardorobertomotalvao) (Leonardorobertomotalvao)
listing.summary: The author reports a working prototype on one Windows 10 PC. Continuous gameplay coverage is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American BLUS30443 decrypted EBOOT.ELF and complete PS3_GAME. Follow the project’s exact accepted EBOOT SHA-256 requirements.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the alpha 0.2 WPF/.NET 8 launcher or source-build instructions to prepare a local copy in your own installation.

warnings: The author reports a working prototype on one Windows 10 PC. Continuous gameplay coverage is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
